{{Top|leg}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained '''penal colonies''' on diferent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to keep prisoners in. An Imperial penal colony was generally considered worse than a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] and was usually reserved to [[Class One infraction/Legends|Class One infraction]] offenders.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

One such colony was present on [[Garen IV/Legends|Garen IV]],<ref name="FAJ8">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref> where [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Stevan Makintay]] was incarcerated in the facility around [[2_BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="Date Note">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of {{JournalCite|8|Firepower}} to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. "Firerpower" states that [[Stevan Makintay]] was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] in the colony five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of the story, which equates to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> for a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before being freed.
